verdict.rationale: Godot ships an official command-line interface (godot binary with --headless, export, script-run flags) documented extensively and confirmed via runtime probe, enabling scripted/agentic automation such as CI builds and exports. Missing for 10: no AI-specific CLI features (e.g., structured/agent-friendly output modes), no independent hands-on validation of CLI scripting workflows beyond docs, and no llms.txt or machine-readable docs mirror.
